localSourceDocumentation.statement: Pinned Ruffle 0.4.1 documents NetworkingAccessMode.None in its local source as not implemented.

enforcement.authority: Playwright BrowserContext request and WebSocket routing
enforcement.statement: Because NetworkingAccessMode.None is documented as not implemented in pinned Ruffle 0.4.1, the browser-context route interception is the network enforcement boundary for this diagnostic.
enforcement.httpPolicy: Allow only exact page GET, exact SWF API GET, same-origin /_next GET, and same-origin /api/ruffle GET; abort and record every other HTTP request.
enforcement.webSocketPolicy: Abort and record every WebSocket connection before any server connection is made.

toolBoundary.statement: This binds the fixed probes, their direct legacy response helper, package lock and installed Ruffle metadata/source map, the local reference player/page/APIs/access guard/catalog boundary, layout CSS, and every local Ruffle JS/WASM asset named by the 94 observed responses. It does not retroactively hash the historical HTTP response bodies.

acceptanceBoundary.statement: The index verifies a current-input-bound, explicitly UI-activated, nondeterministic local Ruffle observation for every L10 release member and EN/ES route. It creates no deterministic frame, original-runtime, SWF-language, audio, fidelity, RMSE, current-JavaScript, human, owner, completion, strict, whole-lesson, or publication evidence.
